    return result


def agentic(
    user_prompt: str,
    *,
    model: str,
    system_prompt: str | None = None,
    allowed_tools: list[str] | None = None,
    cwd: str,
    max_budget_usd: float | None = None,
    permission_mode: str = "auto",  # accepted for parity; unused
    max_turns: int | None = None,
    # Session clock: the loop raises CallTimeoutError before starting a turn once this many
    # seconds (effort-scaled) have elapsed; a turn already in flight is bound by request_timeout.
    timeout: int | None = None,
    tag: str | None = None,
    # `extra_tools` are Anthropic-shape schemas; `extra_dispatch(name, input)` runs one and
    # returns its string result, or None to DEFER to localtools. A caller tool is the caller's to
    # log and size-cap in its own dispatch; this loop only caps and logs the localtools IT runs.
    extra_tools: list[dict] | None = None,
    extra_dispatch=None,
    # Per-turn output ceiling, defaulting to AGENTIC_MAX_TOKENS (16k). `via: cli`'s agentic leg
    # accepts no such parameter in either shape, so it stays on its own default and the dispatcher
    # warns once instead of silently dropping a configured ceiling.
    max_output_tokens: int | None = None,
    # Structured output for the AGENTIC loop. Without it, many S4 units on this route fail to parse
    # as an InvestigationOutcome.
    # Published as a TOOL, not a `response_format`, because the loop must keep its read tools
    # usable.
    response_model: type[BaseModel] | None = None,
    # This model's own declared output-token ceiling, when one exists —
    # bounds the doubled truncation retry (see `_check_terminal_finish`).
    # None keeps the pre-existing unbounded-retry behaviour.
    output_cap: int | None = None,
    # Out-of-loop EvidenceGate enforcement: called right after a structured submit VALIDATES,
    # before it is accepted as the final answer. Bounded by the gate's own `max_rejections`, NOT
    # by `STRUCTURED_REASK_MAX`, which bounds schema malformation — a different failure.
    submit_guard: Callable[[], str | None] | None = None,
    # Out-of-loop tool WITHDRAWAL: called at the top of every turn; a returned name
    # is dropped from `base_kw["tools"]` for the remaining turns instead of staying bound
    # so the model can keep spending turns on calls the adapter's budget only refuses.
    # Mirrors `ToolCallBudget.wrap_model_call`'s in-loop withdrawal on `via: deepagents`.
    # `None` keeps every existing caller (none of which passes this) byte-identical.
    exhausted_tools: Callable[[], frozenset[str]] | None = None,
    # Reasoning-effort tier, translated through the same `EffortLevel` vocabulary
    # `via: deepagents` uses, sent as `reasoning_effort`, and dropped + remembered on a 400/422
    # exactly like `prompt_cache_key`.
    effort: str | None = None,
    # The models-entry `use_responses_api` override: True/False pin the transport outright,
    # None (the default for every pre-existing caller) leaves it to the learned tools-conflict
    # trigger — see `_initial_transport`. Tool-less calls never read this; `prompt()` has no
    # such parameter and always stays on Chat Completions.
    use_responses_api: bool | None = None,
) -> str:
    _warn_max_budget_unenforced("agentic", max_budget_usd)
    client = _get_client()
    # Two clocks compose: request_timeout bounds a call already in flight; the session clock
    # below (derived from `timeout`) stops the loop from STARTING a turn past its budget.
    request_timeout = effort_scaled_seconds(
        DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, effort, kind=ClockKind.REQUEST)
    session_budget = (effort_scaled_seconds(timeout, effort, kind=ClockKind.SESSION)
                      if timeout else None)
    session_t0 = time.monotonic()
    transport = _initial_transport(model, use_responses_api)
    turns_cap = int(max_turns) if max_turns else _MAX_TURNS
    out_cap = int(max_output_tokens) if max_output_tokens else _AGENTIC_MAX_TOK
    if output_cap is not None:
        out_cap = min(out_cap, output_cap)
    learned_cap = _LEARNED_OUTPUT_CAP.get(model)
    if learned_cap is not None:
        out_cap = min(out_cap, learned_cap)
    # `None` = unspecified (read-only default); `[]` = the caller wants no localtools. See
    # the same note in backends.llm.sdk.agentic — folding them together makes "none"
    # inexpressible and duplicates the tools of a caller that supplies its own.
    allowed = list(DEFAULT_READ_TOOLS) if allowed_tools is None else list(allowed_tools)
    ok_tools, missing = _localtools.supported(allowed)
    if missing:
        raise NotImplementedError(
            f"via:openai agentic() does not implement tools {missing}. "
            f"Supported: {sorted(ok_tools)}. Keep this role on `via: cli` "
            f"or drop the unsupported tool from allowed_tools."
        )
    tools = [*_localtools.schemas_for(ok_tools),
             *(_anthropic_tool_to_openai(t) for t in (extra_tools or []))]
    advertised = ok_tools + [t.get("name") for t in (extra_tools or [])]
    if response_model is not None:
        tools.append(_anthropic_tool_to_openai(response_model_tool(response_model)))
        advertised = [*advertised, RESPONSE_MODEL_TOOL_NAME]

    messages: list[dict] = []
    if system_prompt:
        messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system_prompt})
    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user_prompt})

    console.write(f"    [openai] agentic -> {model}{f' [{tag}]' if tag else ''} "
                  f"(tools={advertised}, cwd={cwd})")

    base_kw: dict = {"model": model, "tools": tools}
    if model in _USE_LEGACY_MAXTOK:
        base_kw["max_tokens"] = out_cap
    else:
        base_kw["max_completion_tokens"] = out_cap
    # Built ONCE from THIS SESSION's rendered lead and reused unchanged every turn: sibling
    # sessions share only tools+system, so digesting the system prompt alone collapses a whole
    # stage onto the ring. Keying on the growing tail instead would churn the key each turn.
    if _cache_markers_enabled() and model not in _NO_CACHE_KEY_MODELS:
        base_kw["prompt_cache_key"] = _prompt_cache_key(
            tag, model, cache_prefix=(system_prompt or "") + user_prompt,
            preceding=json.dumps(tools, default=str))
    base_kw.update(_reasoning_effort_kw(model, effort, transport, with_tools=True))

    final_text = ""
    tool_calls_total = 0
    # One reminder only, spent when the model answers in prose while a schema is
    # being forced. A second would just burn turns on a model that cannot comply.
    schema_nudged = False
    # Bounds the submit-validation re-ask ladder below independently of the
    # overall turn budget: a model that keeps mis-shaping the same submit
    # must not spend the WHOLE turn budget on retries that keep failing the
    # same way (shared with sdk.py's identical ladder).
    submit_rejects = 0
    # Names already dropped from `base_kw["tools"]`, so the withdrawal below only
    # rebuilds the list (and prints) the turn a name is newly exhausted, not every turn.
    withdrawn: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
    for turn in range(1, turns_cap + 1):
        if session_budget and time.monotonic() - session_t0 >= session_budget:
            # The orphaned turn is discarded today anyway: stopping here just stops its billing.
            raise call_timeout_error(
                stage=tag or "", route="openai", budget_s=session_budget, effort=effort,
                cause_text=f"session clock exceeded {session_budget:g}s before turn {turn}")
        if exhausted_tools is not None:
            newly_exhausted = exhausted_tools() - withdrawn
            if newly_exhausted:
                withdrawn |= newly_exhausted
                base_kw["tools"] = [
                    t for t in base_kw["tools"]
                    if t.get("function", {}).get("name") not in withdrawn]
                console.write(f"    [openai] withdrawing exhausted tool(s) "
                              f"{sorted(newly_exhausted)} for the remaining turns"
                              f"{f' [{tag}]' if tag else ''}")
        resp = None
        shrinks = 0
        transients = 0
        # (model, tier) and the original exception while one server-error probe is in
        # flight; None once it is answered (by success or by the raise below).
        server_error_probe = None
        server_error_exc = None
        while resp is None:
            try:
                _t0 = time.monotonic()
                turn_client = _turn_client(client, session_t0, session_budget, request_timeout)
                resp = _send_turn(turn_client, transport, messages, base_kw)
                note_budget_use(time.monotonic() - _t0, request_timeout, effort)
            except (openai.BadRequestError, openai.UnprocessableEntityError) as e:
                _raise_if_refusal_rejection(e, tag=tag)
                low = rejection_text(e).lower()
                agentic_budget_key = (_MAX_TOKENS_KEY if _MAX_TOKENS_KEY in base_kw
                                      else _MAX_COMPLETION_TOKENS_KEY)
                if (model not in _LEARNED_OUTPUT_CAP
                        and (_MAX_TOKENS_KEY in low or _MAX_COMPLETION_TOKENS_KEY in low
                             or _MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_KEY in low)):
                    learned = _learned_cap_from_body(
                        low, requested=base_kw[agentic_budget_key])
                    if learned is not None:
                        _LEARNED_OUTPUT_CAP[model] = learned
                        warn_once(
                            _WARNED_DROPS, f"learned_cap:{model}",
                            f"WARN [openai]: {model} rejected "
                            f"{agentic_budget_key}={base_kw[agentic_budget_key]} "
                            f"— learned its real output cap ({learned}) from "
                            f"the gateway's own error and will use it for the "
                            f"rest of this process. Set models.<role>."
                            f"max_tokens: {learned} to skip this extra "
                            f"round-trip next time.")
                        base_kw[agentic_budget_key] = learned
                        continue
                if "max_completion_tokens" in base_kw and "max_completion_tokens" in low:
                    _USE_LEGACY_MAXTOK.add(model)
                    base_kw["max_tokens"] = base_kw.pop("max_completion_tokens")
                    continue
                # Mirrors prompt()'s branch: never fail the loop over an optimisation-only field.
                if "prompt_cache_key" in base_kw and "prompt_cache_key" in low:
                    _NO_CACHE_KEY_MODELS.add(model)
                    base_kw.pop("prompt_cache_key", None)
                    console.write(f"    [openai] {model} rejected `prompt_cache_key` — "
                                  f"retrying without it")
                    continue
                # The shared classifier sorts the rejection into tools-conflict, field or tier;
                # the memory and the ladder are shared with the deepagents client. tools_conflict
                # is tested first: its body also says "not supported", which the field arm below
                # would otherwise swallow as a drop -- and the dropped request is the one that
                # keeps failing.
                effort_outcome = _handle_effort_rejection(
                    model, base_kw, e, transport=transport, override=use_responses_api)
                if effort_outcome is not None:
                    if effort_outcome.fail:
                        # The forced 'none' remedy already failed once (or every tier bottomed
                        # out): re-forcing it would cycle forever. No further resend can help.
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            f"OpenAI agentic call failed (status={e.status_code}, "
                            f"model={model}, turn={turn}): {_summarise_status_error(e)}\n"
                            f"  This model rejects reasoning_effort alongside function "
                            f"tools at every value, including 'none'. Set "
                            f"`use_responses_api: true` on this models entry, or route "
                            f"the role via: deepagents, to keep native reasoning with tools."
                        ) from e
                    transport = effort_outcome.transport
                    continue
                if _handle_include_rejection(model, e, transport=transport):
                    continue
                if (transport == TRANSPORT_RESPONSES
                        and _responses_failure_falls_back(model, e)):
                    _fall_back_to_chat(model, base_kw)
                    transport = TRANSPORT_CHAT
                    continue
                # Context-window overflow: evict the oldest oversized tool result and retry.
                if (_CTX_OVERFLOW_RX.search(low) and shrinks < 16
                        and _shrink_history(messages)):
                    shrinks += 1
                    console.write(f"      [openai] context overflow (turn {turn}); "
                                  f"evicted oldest tool output [{shrinks}], retrying")
                    continue
                if _auth_failure_oai(e):  # credential prose under 400/422, as the status arm
                    raise AuthenticationError(redact(str(e))[:400],
                                              status_code=e.status_code, backend="openai") from e
                # 400/422 are non-retryable per the docs; this is the bounded gateway heuristic
                if _is_transient_oai(e) and transients < _AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES:
                    transients += 1
                    wait = jittered_delay(min(60, 10 * transients))
                    if overrun := wait_overrun(wait, session_t0, session_budget,
                                               stage=tag or "", route="openai", effort=effort):
                        raise overrun from e
                    console.write(f"      [openai] transient {e.status_code} (turn "
                                  f"{turn}, retry {transients}/{_AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES}); "
                                  f"waiting {wait:.1f}s")
                    time.sleep(wait)
                    continue
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"OpenAI agentic call failed (status={e.status_code}, "
                    f"model={model}, turn={turn}): {_summarise_status_error(e)}"
                ) from e
            except openai.APIStatusError as e:
                _raise_if_refusal_rejection(e, tag=tag)
                # Auth FIRST, exactly as prompt() decides it: a mid-scan expired token is
                # unhealable, and this loop's only other option is to burn four transient
                # retries and then raise a generic RuntimeError — losing VVAH-E001, the
                # credential remediation block and the batch halt.
                if _auth_failure_oai(e):
                    raise AuthenticationError(redact(str(e))[:400],
                                              status_code=e.status_code,
                                              backend="openai") from e
                if _is_transient_oai(e) and transients < _AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES:
                    transients += 1
                    wait = jittered_delay(min(60, 10 * transients))
                    if overrun := wait_overrun(wait, session_t0, session_budget,
                                               stage=tag or "", route="openai", effort=effort):
                        raise overrun from e
                    console.write(f"      [openai] transient {e.status_code} (turn "
                                  f"{turn}, retry {transients}/{_AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES}); "
                                  f"waiting {wait:.1f}s")
                    time.sleep(wait)
                    continue
                if (transport == TRANSPORT_RESPONSES
                        and model not in TRANSPORT_MEMORY.responses_proven):
                    # A persistent 5xx on a transport this model never completed a turn on:
                    # treat it like any other unproven-Responses failure, not a tier problem.
                    _fall_back_to_chat(model, base_kw)
                    transport = TRANSPORT_CHAT
                    continue
                if server_error_probe is not None:
                    # The probe resend also failed: an outage, not a tier problem.
                    # Raise the first error, not this one, and record nothing.
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        f"OpenAI agentic call failed (status="
                        f"{server_error_exc.status_code}, model={model}, turn="
                        f"{turn}): {_summarise_status_error(server_error_exc)}"
                    ) from server_error_exc
                sent = base_kw.get("reasoning_effort")
                # 5xx only (429 is a rate limit, not a server fault); REASONING_OFF has no
                # lower rung to probe.
                can_probe = (sent is not None and sent != REASONING_OFF
                            and e.status_code in SERVER_ERROR_STATUS)
                nxt = next_effort_tier(sent) if can_probe else None
                if nxt is not None and EFFORT_REJECTIONS.probe_once(
                        claimed := _tiers_key(model, sent, transport)):
                    server_error_probe, server_error_exc = (model, sent, claimed), e
                    base_kw["reasoning_effort"] = nxt
                    continue
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"OpenAI agentic call failed (status={e.status_code}, "
                    f"model={model}, turn={turn}): {_summarise_status_error(e)}"
                ) from e
            except openai.APIConnectionError as e:
                if is_timeout_failure(e):
                    raise call_timeout_error(
                        stage=tag or "", route="openai", budget_s=request_timeout, effort=effort,
                        cause_text=f"OpenAI agentic call exceeded "
                                   f"{request_timeout:g}s (turn={turn})") from e
                if proxy := proxy_error(e, backend="openai"):
                    raise proxy from e
                if transients < _AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES:
                    transients += 1
                    wait = jittered_delay(min(60, 10 * transients))
                    if overrun := wait_overrun(wait, session_t0, session_budget,
                                               stage=tag or "", route="openai", effort=effort):
                        raise overrun from e
                    console.write(f"      [openai] agentic connection error (turn {turn}, "
                                  f"retry {transients}/{_AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES}); "
                                  f"waiting {wait:.1f}s")
                    time.sleep(wait)
                    continue
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"OpenAI agentic connection error (model={model}, turn={turn}): "
                    f"{e}\n  cause: {_cause_chain(e)}"
                ) from e

        if server_error_probe is not None:
            probed_model, probed_sent, probed_key = server_error_probe
            if learned := EFFORT_REJECTIONS.recovered_twice(probed_key):
                EFFORT_REJECTIONS.tiers.add(probed_key)
            COUNTERS.bump("llm_effort_tier_stepped_down_on_server_error")
            warn_once(
                _WARNED_DROPS, f"server_error_tier:{probed_model}:{probed_sent}:{learned}",
                f"WARN [openai]: {probed_model} returned a server error at "
                f"reasoning_effort={probed_sent!r} and succeeded at "
                f"{base_kw.get('reasoning_effort')!r}; using {base_kw.get('reasoning_effort')!r} "
                f"{'for the rest of this run' if learned else 'for this session'}.")
        _record_usage(getattr(resp, "usage", None))
        choice = _first_choice(resp, model=model, tag=tag, turn=turn)
        msg = choice.message
        calls = getattr(msg, "tool_calls", None) or []
        finish = getattr(choice, "finish_reason", None)

        assistant = {
            "role": "assistant",
            "content": msg.content,
            "tool_calls": [tc.model_dump() for tc in calls] if calls else None,
            # Stripped before the Chat wire (to_chat_messages); carries Responses replay state
            # only. A native Chat reply has no `.reasoning_items` attribute, so this is `[]`.
            REASONING_ITEMS_KEY: getattr(msg, "reasoning_items", None) or [],
        }
        messages.append(assistant)

        # Must be checked even when `calls` is non-empty: OpenAI reports finish_reason=="length"
        # when generation is cut off MID-tool-call too, leaving `tool_calls` populated with
        # unparseable `arguments` JSON the dispatch loop would silently coerce to `{}` instead of
        # raising VVAH-E005.
        if not calls or finish == OPENAI_FINISH_LENGTH:
            retry_client = _turn_client(client, session_t0, session_budget, request_timeout)

            def _retry_send(kw: dict, *, _tc: openai.OpenAI = retry_client,
                            _tp: str = transport) -> Any:
                return _send_turn(_tc, _tp, messages, kw)

            choice, msg, override = _check_terminal_finish(
                choice, msg, send=_retry_send, messages=messages, call_kw=base_kw,
                appended=True, model=model, tag=tag, requested=out_cap,
                response_model=response_model, dispatchable=True,
                output_cap=output_cap, effort=effort, request_timeout=request_timeout)
            if override is not None:
                console.write(f"    [openai] agentic done in {turn} turn(s), "
                              f"{tool_calls_total} tool call(s), structured reply")
                return override
            # A doubled-budget retry may have landed on a tool call (the
            # clipped attempt was mid-way through one) — recompute `calls`
            # and, if so, fall through to the dispatch loop below exactly as
            # a first-try tool_calls reply would.
            calls = getattr(msg, "tool_calls", None) or []
            if not calls:
                final_text = (msg.content or "").strip()
                # A schema was forced but the model replied in prose. Ask once, by
                # name, before giving up: returning the prose is what used to lose the
                # unit downstream. If it still will not call the tool we return the
                # text anyway, so this is never worse than the old behaviour.
                if response_model is not None and not schema_nudged:
                    schema_nudged = True
                    COUNTERS.bump("llm_structured_prose_reask")
                    log.warning(Event.STRUCTURED_PROSE_REASK, route="openai", model=model,
                                tool=RESPONSE_MODEL_TOOL_NAME)
                    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": STRUCTURED_PROSE_REASK})
                    continue
                console.write(f"    [openai] agentic done in {turn} turn(s), "
                              f"{tool_calls_total} tool call(s)")
                return final_text

        for i, tc in enumerate(calls):
            tool_calls_total += 1
            name = tc.function.name
            try:
                args = json.loads(tc.function.arguments or "{}")
                args_valid = True
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                # The submit tool keeps `{}`: its validation ladder below re-asks by name.
                args, args_valid = {}, False
                # The gateway rejects a replayed invalid string (function.arguments must be
                # valid JSON): rewrite the bound assistant turn so the retry never resends it.
                assistant["tool_calls"][i]["function"]["arguments"] = "{}"
            if response_model is not None and name == RESPONSE_MODEL_TOOL_NAME:
                # The structured reply IS the final answer, so the loop ends here
                # rather than feeding a tool result back. Validated before
                # returning and re-dumped, so the caller gets canonical JSON for
                # the model it asked for instead of whatever key order or extra
                # keys the model emitted.
                try:
                    validated = response_model.model_validate(args)
                except Exception as exc:
                    # Bounded by STRUCTURED_REASK_MAX independently of the overall turn budget, so
                    # one malformed submit that keeps failing the same way cannot spend the whole
                    # ladder — losing the unit to it is the failure this seam exists to stop.
                    submit_rejects += 1
                    COUNTERS.bump("llm_structured_submit_rejected")
                    if submit_rejects >= STRUCTURED_REASK_MAX:
                        log.warning(Event.STRUCTURED_SUBMIT_REJECTED, route="openai",
                                    tool=RESPONSE_MODEL_TOOL_NAME, error=type(exc).__name__,
                                    rejects=submit_rejects)
                        detail, _ = structured_failure_detail(exc)
                        # recovered=True: raw submit returned; the stage's own parser decides
                        _errlog.log(
                            tag or "openai", tag or "structured",
                            f"{RESPONSE_MODEL_TOOL_NAME} rejected {submit_rejects} time(s); "
                            f"raw submit returned",
                            detail=detail, reason="llm_structured_reask_gave_up", recovered=True)
                        return json.dumps(args)
                    console.write(f"    [openai] {RESPONSE_MODEL_TOOL_NAME} rejected "
                                  f"({type(exc).__name__}) — re-asking")
                    messages.append({
                        "role": "tool",
                        "tool_call_id": tc.id,
                        "content": (f"Rejected: {str(exc)[:600]}. Fix the named "
                                    f"fields and call the tool again."),
                    })
                    continue
                if submit_guard is not None:
                    hold_text = submit_guard()
                    if hold_text is not None:
                        console.write(f"    [openai] {RESPONSE_MODEL_TOOL_NAME} accepted but "
                                      f"evidence-gated — re-asking")
                        messages.append({
                            "role": "tool",
                            "tool_call_id": tc.id,
                            "content": hold_text,
                        })
                        continue
                console.write(f"    [openai] agentic done in {turn} turn(s), "
                              f"{tool_calls_total} tool call(s), structured reply")
                return validated.model_dump_json()
            # A caller-supplied tool goes to extra_dispatch (the caller logs + caps it); a
            # localtools name returns None and is executed, capped, and logged by
            # _run_localtool — logging/capping follow whichever layer actually ran the tool.
            # Unparseable arguments run nothing; the error turn lets the model re-issue the call.
            if args_valid:
                result = extra_dispatch(name, args) if extra_dispatch is not None else None
                if result is None:
                    result = _run_localtool(name, args, ok_tools=ok_tools, cwd=cwd, tag=tag)
            else:
                COUNTERS.bump("openai_tool_args_invalid_json")
                # Model-emitted and ungated (any string): redact() BEFORE the cut
                log.warning(Event.TOOL_ARGS_INVALID_JSON, route="openai", tool=redact(name)[:200],
                            tag=tag or None)
                result = "ERROR: tool arguments were not valid JSON"
            messages.append({
                "role": "tool",
                "tool_call_id": tc.id,
                "content": result,
            })

    log.warning(Event.LLM_TURN_CAP_EXHAUSTED, turns_cap=turns_cap, model=model, tag=tag)
    COUNTERS.bump("llm_turn_cap_exhausted")
    # The forced-final call drops `tools` so a tool-happy model cannot spend
    # another turn -- but when a schema is being forced, the submit tool is the
    # ONLY way to answer, so it is kept (alone) and required. Dropping it here
    # would reintroduce the unparseable-prose reply for exactly the runs that
    # exhausted their budget.
    forced_kw: dict = {k: v for k, v in base_kw.items() if k != "tools"}
    forced_kw["model"] = model
    if response_model is not None:
        forced_kw["tools"] = [
            _anthropic_tool_to_openai(response_model_tool(response_model))]
        if model not in _NO_TOOL_CHOICE_MODELS:
            forced_kw["tool_choice"] = {
                "type": "function",
                "function": {"name": RESPONSE_MODEL_TOOL_NAME}}
        instruction = (f"Tool budget exhausted. Call "
                       f"`{RESPONSE_MODEL_TOOL_NAME}` now with what you have "
                       f"established so far; it is the only way to reply.")
    else:
        instruction = ("Tool budget exhausted. Reply now with your final answer "
                       "based on what you have read so far; do not call tools.")
    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": instruction})
    final_transients = 0
    while True:
        try:
            _t0 = time.monotonic()
            final_client = _turn_client(client, session_t0, session_budget, request_timeout)
            resp = _send_turn(final_client, transport, messages, forced_kw)
            note_budget_use(time.monotonic() - _t0, request_timeout, effort)
            break
        except (openai.BadRequestError, openai.UnprocessableEntityError) as e:
            _raise_if_refusal_rejection(e, tag=tag)
            # An endpoint that refuses `tool_choice` must not cost the unit:
            # remember it and retry with the tool merely advertised, mirroring
            # how `prompt()` degrades its structured-output tiers.
            if ("tool_choice" in forced_kw and "tool_choice" in rejection_text(e).lower()):
                _NO_TOOL_CHOICE_MODELS.add(model)
                forced_kw.pop("tool_choice", None)
                console.write(f"    [openai] {model} rejected `tool_choice` on the "
                              f"forced-final call — retrying without it")
                continue
            if _auth_failure_oai(e):  # credential prose under 400/422: same rule as the status arm
                raise AuthenticationError(redact(str(e))[:400],
                                          status_code=e.status_code, backend="openai") from e
            # 400/422 are non-retryable per the docs; this is the bounded gateway heuristic
            if _is_transient_oai(e) and final_transients < _AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES:
                final_transients += 1
                wait = jittered_delay(min(60, 10 * final_transients))
                if overrun := wait_overrun(wait, session_t0, session_budget,
                                           stage=tag or "", route="openai", effort=effort):
                    raise overrun from e
                console.write(f"      [openai] forced-final transient {e.status_code} "
                              f"(retry {final_transients}/{_AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES}); "
                              f"waiting {wait:.1f}s")
                time.sleep(wait)
                continue
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"OpenAI agentic forced-final failed (status={e.status_code}, "
                f"model={model}): {_summarise_status_error(e)}"
            ) from e
        except openai.APIStatusError as e:
            _raise_if_refusal_rejection(e, tag=tag)
            if _auth_failure_oai(e):   # auth-first, same rule as the turn loop above
                raise AuthenticationError(redact(str(e))[:400],
                                          status_code=e.status_code,
                                          backend="openai") from e
            if _is_transient_oai(e) and final_transients < _AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES:
                final_transients += 1
                wait = jittered_delay(min(60, 10 * final_transients))
                if overrun := wait_overrun(wait, session_t0, session_budget,
                                           stage=tag or "", route="openai", effort=effort):
                    raise overrun from e
                console.write(f"      [openai] forced-final transient {e.status_code} "
                              f"(retry {final_transients}/{_AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES}); "
                              f"waiting {wait:.1f}s")
                time.sleep(wait)
                continue
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"OpenAI agentic forced-final failed (status={e.status_code}, "
                f"model={model}): {_summarise_status_error(e)}"
            ) from e
        except openai.APIConnectionError as e:
            if is_timeout_failure(e):
                raise call_timeout_error(
                    stage=tag or "", route="openai", budget_s=request_timeout, effort=effort,
                    cause_text=f"OpenAI agentic forced-final exceeded "
                               f"{request_timeout:g}s") from e
            if proxy := proxy_error(e, backend="openai"):
                raise proxy from e
            if final_transients < _AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES:
                final_transients += 1
                wait = jittered_delay(min(60, 10 * final_transients))
                if overrun := wait_overrun(wait, session_t0, session_budget,
                                           stage=tag or "", route="openai", effort=effort):
                    raise overrun from e
                console.write(f"      [openai] forced-final connection error "
                              f"(retry {final_transients}/{_AGENTIC_TRANSIENT_RETRIES}); "
                              f"waiting {wait:.1f}s")
                time.sleep(wait)
                continue
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"OpenAI agentic forced-final connection error (model={model}): "
                f"{e}\n  cause: {_cause_chain(e)}"
            ) from e
    _record_usage(getattr(resp, "usage", None))
    final_choice = _first_choice(resp, model=model, tag=tag, turn=turns_cap)

    def _final_retry_send(kw: dict, *, _tc: openai.OpenAI = final_client,
                          _tp: str = transport) -> Any:
        return _send_turn(_tc, _tp, messages, kw)

    final_choice, final_msg, override = _check_terminal_finish(
        final_choice, final_choice.message, send=_final_retry_send, messages=messages,
        call_kw=forced_kw, appended=False, model=model, tag=tag,
        requested=out_cap, response_model=response_model,
        output_cap=output_cap, effort=effort, request_timeout=request_timeout)
    if override is not None:
        return override
    if response_model is not None:
        for tc in (getattr(final_msg, "tool_calls", None) or []):
            if tc.function.name != RESPONSE_MODEL_TOOL_NAME:
                continue
            try:
                args = json.loads(tc.function.arguments or "{}")
                return response_model.model_validate(args).model_dump_json()
            except Exception as exc:
                # Out of turns and the submit is malformed: fall through to the
                # prose below so the stage's own parser still gets a chance,
                # rather than raising and losing the unit outright.
                log.warning(Event.RESPONSE_MODEL_FORCED_FINAL_INVALID,
                            tool=RESPONSE_MODEL_TOOL_NAME, error=type(exc).__name__)
    return (final_msg.content or "").strip()

# Newer models (o-series, gpt-5+) need max_completion_tokens and REJECT temperature.
# Prompt caching rides the provider's IMPLICIT cache, never an explicit breakpoint:
# `prompt_cache_breakpoint` would require switching the user turn to a content-block list, a
# request-shape change a strict gateway can 400 on with no signature to self-heal from.
# TRANSPORT: tool-less calls (prompt()) always speak Chat Completions. agentic() starts there
# too, and stays there, UNTIL a model's own gateway says tools and reasoning_effort conflict on
# Chat Completions — the measured cost of silencing reasoning_effort to 'none' instead (today's
# only Chat-side remedy) is real: it measurably lowers finding recall on affected models. From
# that point on, THAT MODEL's tool turns move natively to the Responses API: same loop, same tools,
# reasoning replayed via encrypted_content under store=False. The one canonical transcript stays
# Chat-shaped throughout; `openai_responses.py`'s pure functions translate it at send time, and
# strip the Responses-only replay keys (`_reasoning_items`, `_item_id`) before any Chat send.
# The move is LEARNED (by gateway wording) or PINNED (`use_responses_api:` on the models entry),
# never guessed from a model name. A model whose gateway supports neither leg at all (the
# measured broken set, or one learned Chat-only after a failed Responses call) stays on Chat
# with reasoning_effort='none' on tool turns, same as before this transport existed.
# Annotation-only: `agentic` never constructs one, it just validates through
# the class the caller passes.
# No separate mid-stream transport clause, deliberately: on openai 3.19.2
# `Stream._iter_events` wraps the WHOLE body iteration, re-raising transport errors as
# `openai.APIConnectionError`, so a mid-stream drop already arrives at that arm.
# What that makes load-bearing: the APIConnectionError arm must NOT read an already-streaming
# failure as a terminal VVAH-E002, so `streamed_any` gates the ProxyError classification.
# Bounded, not `.*`: an unanchored wildcard let a 400 reading
# "invalid_request_error ... prompt is too long: 300000 tokens" match, so an
# oversized chunk was logged three times as an authentication error and the
# operator had no way to see the real cause.
# \btoken\b: `max_tokens`/`completion tokens` cap rejections must not read as auth.
# Match a human-readable block reason in a corp-proxy/DLP page: `reason=` param, or rsn span.
# Bearer tokens/api keys/cookies a proxy may reflect back in an error body; redact before logging.
# sk-XXXXXX… → sk-XXXXXX***
# Bearer <tok> → Bearer ***
# Header: <val> → Header: ***
# Lazy, thread-safe singleton client (s4 runs in a ThreadPoolExecutor).
# cache_markers "off" suppresses the `prompt_cache_key` field; this route emits no explicit
# breakpoint (see the module docstring), so there is nothing else for the switch to suppress.
# Accepted only to DIAGNOSE it: this route has no mTLS plumbing, and
# silently ignoring an operator's client_cert leaves them believing
# mTLS is active. Mirrors the `via: cli` warning (cli.py:388).
# Two retry layers, deliberately (same call as sdk.py's). `max_retries` stays at the
